title: AI Ops Diagnostics
description: Why enter/skip AI, why outbound text changes, access control, and config backup.

status.hint: Click a badge to expand details. Bot / session / follow-up state is in-process memory and clears on restart.

access.title: AI black / white lists
access.desc: Entry gate; saved immediately. Non-empty whitelist restricts AI to listed IDs only.
access.blackHint: Matching user/group IDs never enter AI
access.whiteHint: When non-empty, only listed IDs may enter AI

security.title: Security & follow-up policy
security.desc: Only gate/exit and follow-up knobs. Markdown image render / tool recall live under AI basic config.
security.advancedBody: Tool recall, long-markdown-as-image, history merge window, etc. remain in the backend security-output snapshot. Use Config Snapshot export or AI basic config for full keys.

trigger.title: Trigger path replay
trigger.desc: Dry-run: enable → access lists → persona → mention/keyword/follow-up. No LLM call, no send.

output.title: OOC / output normalize preview
output.desc: Simulate outbound text through firewall and normalization.

snapshot.title: Config snapshot export / import
snapshot.desc: Export AI-related config for backup/migration; import writes immediately (be careful in prod).
